privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: ColdLink connects farmers with cold storage near them. This is what we do with your details, in plain words.

collect.title: What we keep
items: Your name and home area, if you add them.
The place you search from, to find cold rooms near you.

why.title: Why we keep it
items: To sign you in with a code sent by SMS.
To find cold rooms near you.
To run your bookings and payments.
To send you SMS about your bookings.

share.title: Who sees it
items: The cold room you book sees your booking and how to reach you.
If you ask for delivery, the delivery partner sees where to collect and who to call.
Our payment and SMS partners get only what they need to take a payment or send a message.

rights.title: Your choices
items: You agree to this notice when you create your ColdLink ID.
You can ask us to show you, correct or delete your details.
Only ColdLink staff who need your phone number can see it.

privacy.law: This notice follows the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023. To ask about your details, contact ColdLink support.
